title: Foo Bar Taxi Dashboard API
description: Design an analytics schema with materialized views from pre-seeded raw NYC taxi data, then build a dashboard backend API with endpoints for trip summaries, daily trends, taxi type breakdowns, and top routes.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must design an analytics schema with materialized views for pre-aggregated data, then build a dashboard backend serving trip summary stats, daily trends, taxi type breakdowns, and top routes over 3M+ rows of NYC taxi data.

tasks.description: Design a proper analytics table in ClickHouse from the raw staging data with appropriate column types, a taxi_type discriminator, and ORDER BY suitable for dashboard queries.
Create materialized views for daily trip aggregates, taxi type breakdowns, and top routes to achieve sub-200ms query performance on 3M+ rows.
Build an HTTP endpoint returning trip summary statistics: total trips, total revenue, average fare, average trip distance.
Build HTTP endpoints for daily trends, taxi type breakdown, and top routes, all backed by materialized views for performance.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse pre-seeded with raw.yellow_trips_2024_01 and raw.green_trips_2024_01 staging tables from NYC TLC parquet files.
